name: long-text
title: Long Text
description: Text whose runs without a space (a long address, base64, a hash) are folded past 1,024 characters, so its layout stays bounded whatever the text: a browser lays such a run out as one word broken anywhere, in time that grows with its length (WebKit) or, kerned in the system font, with its square (Chromium: 256 KiB of one letter, 3s a layout). A folded run (LongRun) shows its first 512 characters, an ellipsis, a button for 16,384 more at a time ("Show 261,632 more characters") and one to copy it whole, and is not kerned; in a link, only its start. LongText folds a string's runs, for text shown as written (a sent message's, ComposerMessage); Markdown folds its own, not in code blocks. Words, however many, are as they were.
